description.en_us: Web-based management interface for iCloudPD. Easily configure multiple iCloud accounts, manage authentication, and monitor photo syncing. This is the companion app to 'iCloudPD' - install both for the complete solution.

tagline.en_us: Manage your iCloud photo syncing with ease

before_install.en_us:
This is the web-based manager for iCloudPD. For the complete solution:

1. Install this 'iCloudPD Manager' first
2. Then install 'iCloudPD' from YizAppStore
3. Access the manager at http://your-server-ip:8000
4. Add your iCloud accounts and configure sync settings

The manager will help you authenticate with iCloud and manage the iCloudPD container.
